name: claude2grokbot
description: Let Claude (or any MCP client) wake an executor agent that isn't running, hand it tasks, and collect results. Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object, zero runtime dependencies.

MCP_TOKENS.description: Bearer token(s) for MCP clients such as Claude Code. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Separate several with commas.

EXECUTOR_KEY.description: Key your executor uses to claim tasks. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Long password for the OAuth consent screen (needed for claude.ai). At least 12 characters.

WAKE_URL.description: Executor wake webhook URL, e.g. the Grok Bot routine webhook **POST to** URL. Use `none` for poll-only.

WAKE_SECRET.description: Wake webhook credential, e.g. the Grok Bot routine webhook **key**.
